quantiles: Empirical nearest-rank; cold n=10 per entry, warm n=100 at 10k/100k and n=20 at 1m except semantic cache reuse n=99/19. The first aborted 1m run used n=100; its partial rows are separate. No outlier trimming. Missing body samples remain in the quantile denominator as unbounded (JSON null). The initial one-cold-sample run is separate.

native.cold_definition: Ten fresh service/helper openings per entry; OS/model/shader caches may be warm; opening the panel requests prewarming. Reopen and model verification occur outside the timed native edit.

contention.scope: Actual composer/native commits, production service/indexer, real background document embeddings and query model; base corpus is synthetic noise plus one real winning passage. Layout/display is not a GPU fence; timer gaps include polling/accessibility work.
